sentences.span: Trump said he will soon decide whether to “make a deal” with Iran or “finish it off” (CNBC). Trump threatened “another little Operation Epic Fury” but ruled out immediate action
sentences.why: The tanker-attack/Hormuz premise is supported (source-text-all/2026-10-29/22052, 'An attack on a product tanker near Oman raises risks beyond Hormuz'), but the sentence's characterization of Trump's comment as promising the Iran war 'will be wrapped up soon' inverts the actual reporting: Trump's comment was a binary, still-threatening choice between a deal and 'finishing it off,' with markets reacting positively only to the absence of immediate action, not to any statement that the war would end soon. This overstates/changes the direction of what was said.
